items.distractor_fact: V susednom meste v ten istý deň namerali {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring city, they measured {D} °C on that same day.
items.entity_note: A different city's temperature reading, not the city in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Akcie inej spoločnosti sa v ten istý deň obchodovali za {D} €.
items.gloss_en: Shares of another company traded at €{D} on that same day.
items.entity_note: A different company's share price, not the company in the story.

items.gloss_en: The level of a neighboring lake reached {D} m.
items.entity_note: A different lake's water level, not the lake in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Na inom účte v tej istej banke bol tento mesiac vklad vo výške {D} €.
items.gloss_en: At another account in the same bank, this month's deposit amounted to €{D}.
items.entity_note: A different account's deposit amount, not the account in the story.

items.gloss_en: Another gift card had a starting value of €{D}.
items.entity_note: A different gift card's starting value, not the card in the story.

items.gloss_en: Another SIM card in the same household had a data limit of {D} GB.
items.entity_note: A different SIM card's data limit, not the plan in the story.

items.gloss_en: Another household on the same street had expenses of €{D} this month.
items.entity_note: A different household's expenses, not the household in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Hodnota gólov iného tímu v tej istej lige za sezónu bola {D}.
items.gloss_en: The value of another team's goals in the same league for the season was {D}.
items.entity_note: A different team's goal count, not the team in the story; the story's own 'hodnota X bola {D}' frame keeps the bare number invariant since no noun follows it.

items.distractor_fact: Iný malý podnik v tom istom meste zaznamenal tento kvartál stratu vo výške {D} €.
items.gloss_en: Another small business in the same town recorded a loss of €{D} this quarter.
items.entity_note: A different business's loss, not the business in the story.

items.gloss_en: A train on the neighboring line had a measured arrival-time reading of {D} min that same day.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line, whose own schedule is not stated, so it cannot be compared to this train's schedule.

items.distractor_fact: Výťah v susednej budove ukazoval hodnotu podlažia {D}.
items.gloss_en: The lift in a neighboring building showed a floor reading of {D}.
items.entity_note: A different building's lift, whose own ground-floor reference is not stated, so it cannot substitute for this building's ground floor.

items.distractor_fact: Hodnota gólov iného tímu v inom zápase toho dňa bola {D}.
items.gloss_en: The value of another team's goals in a different match that day was {D}.
items.entity_note: A different team in a different match, not either team in the story; uses the 'hodnota X bola {D}' frame to keep the number invariant.
